mechanism: default-off stock-long Q1 inline Metal metadata binding
source_repository: lab-owned mlx2, with stock arithmetic compared against installed MIT MLX source

upstream_reference.use: Existing stock-long arithmetic and buffer-index reference only; this change does not copy or alter upstream kernel arithmetic

modifications: A dedicated strict MLX2_PAGED_Q1_STOCK_LONG_INLINE_METADATA=0|1 selector defaults off and admits only the validated stock-long B2 128-partition geometry
After the existing complete span/page checks, retain the same eight immutable uint32 metadata vectors in the read primitive and reject any vector above the 4096-byte Metal setBytes cap
Compile the unchanged stock-long math with exactly eight metadata address spaces changed from device to constant under a distinct inline library cache key
Bind the same buffer slots 4..11 with set_bytes; leave Q/K/V, dependency, scratch slot 12, scale/stride slots 13..20, reduction, resource barrier and terminal callback unchanged
Expose a dedicated actual post-partial-dispatch metadata counter without changing existing short inline, old split or stock-long partial/reduce counters

validation.cpu: 31 focused pytest checks (including 4 new C++/source/FP16-BF16 offline Metal checks and exact arithmetic source identity) plus 3 direct stock-long source checks passed; native CMake compile/link with -Werror passed
